A fault-specific persistent numerical stop or named R7 rejection may provide that cause if its complete candidate/verification sequence, case/row/body identity and unchanged source linkage support it. The enum name alone is not automatic credit.
For a selected fault case, unchanged run_case already emits exact named row failure and reference through src/lane.rs305-306; no new expected values are needed.
nonqualifying: PublicationEnclosure-only/certificate-only loss of selection; generic work/storage/record drift; top-level Ceiling without attributable reasons; empty/missing attempt records; environment/source/geometry/setup failures; merely nonzero exit.

An early R7 rejection also present under NONE, followed only by new generic publication rejection, is not a numerical-unavailability discriminator. Mixed or unattributed reasons remain a concrete gap.
